currentFullRunRestart.interpretation: All UI contexts closed; only the test-owned shipping worker PID was stopped and a different PID started. The same confirmed result and outbox persisted, and exactly one journal/item/delivery is present after restart. beforeRestart records whether processing had already completed; no pending state is fabricated. Authentication and inspection are separate from the zero-action automatic trigger.

workerRecoveryEvidence.scope: Distinct actual executions. A restart after DONE proves preserved completed state and no duplicate; the separate PENDING-to-DONE execution proves pending-work recovery.

integrationCoverage: Actual mandatory full integration command:280PASS. Later-added test files and changed affected suites have individually recorded passing executions in INTEGRATION_DISCOVERY_INVENTORY_FINAL; overlapping runs are not summed.
retainedFailedAttempts: Historical failures and environment interruptions retain their actual outcomes. finalRequiredRun identifies the applicable mandatory command, including the failed full browser command; browserAcceptance separately binds every affected correction to exact current case coverage.
limitations: Original preimplementation browser measurement explicitly excluded by user; no measured before/after saving claimed.
All normative profiles, people and results used for acceptance are synthetic.
No physical paper printing, real electronic signature, provider sandbox acceptance, production deployment or LMK confirmation performed.
Optional instructor cabinet outside the agreed25MVP; unsupported role remains denied.
Load100 means local concurrent read/autosave HTTP requests, excluding video transfer and rendering; not production capacity.
publication: Exact reviewed allowlist only. Private fixtures, credentials, raw browser traces, runtime logs and personal attachments excluded.

postAcceptanceSourceNormalization.interpretation: Only an extra terminal blank line was removed from two newly added support scripts after browser acceptance. Executed source manifests and browser evidence are immutable; exact reverse bytes and Python AST/PowerShell token equivalence are separately verified.

runtimeHandoff.interpretation: Functional acceptance and real recovery were completed earlier; the attempted post-acceptance restart was rejected by automatic approval review. No retry or alternate launch was performed.
